_comment: Project fidelity config for SPX auth screens. Extends the skill's example with project-specific ignores/deviations. Tolerances match the example; ux.motion is the design's motion-token scale (verified by ux-diff).
_ignoreTextNote: iOS status-bar mock (clock 9:41 + signal/wifi/battery glyphs) drawn in the Figma device frame. Never implemented on web — it's device chrome, not app UI. topInset reserves the band; these TEXT nodes are dropped so they don't perpetually flag as critical MISSING.

deviations.reason: Phone field country-code selector renders the live dial code (+86 ▾) instead of the literal label word 区号. Functional equivalent + better UX; approved 2026-05-28.

ux._motionNote: mismatch/required are error subtypes → they animate on the field's error transition (errorDurationMs 200 / ease-in-out), same as `error`. Without these the diff would compare them to the 150ms default and flag a phantom motion-minor.
